doc: docs/merge-queue-settings.md. The one source for the merge queue rule and the required approving review count of every repository ruleset. Applied by scripts/apply_merge_queue.py (dry-run by default). GitHub does not allow a merge_queue rule in an organization or enterprise ruleset, so it is applied per repository from here.

fast_gate.note: The required check of the queue is the fast gate only; the full suite runs after the merge (docs/optimistic-merge.md). The tool reports a ruleset that does not require it and never adds a check itself: requiring a check that no workflow reports would stop the queue.

review.note: Every repository ruleset's pull_request rule requires no approving review: ci-ok is the gate, and an approval finds nothing it did not (owner standards: ONE CHECK). The enterprise ruleset already requires 0.

exclude.reason: Delivered customer repository: no work unless the customer asks through Kyle.

fast_gate_overrides.reason: The deploy/pins branch is gated by its own check, pin-ok, not by the code gate.

_overrides_shape: overrides: [{"repo": "org/name", "ruleset": "<ruleset name>", "settings": {"max_entries_to_build": 2}, "reason": "..."}]. fast_gate_overrides: [{"repo": "org/name", "ruleset": "<ruleset name>", "context": "pin-ok", "reason": "..."}]. Every entry needs a reason; the settings keys are those under settings.
